newsitem.title: ECUADOR: ECUADOR JAN-JUL BANANA EXPORTS UP 21.9 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ECUADOR JAN-JUL BANANA EXPORTS UP 21.9 PCT.

text.p: Ecuadorean banana exports totaled 2.63 million tonnes in the first seven months of the year, up 21.9 percent from the same period in 1996, the government's National Banana Program said Monday.

"We have grown by 20 percent in the European Union, and in countries of the former Soviet Union, such as Lithuania, growth was 311 percent," National Banana Program marketing manager Jose Riofrio told Reuters.
"We could finish the year with 4.4 million tonnes," he said.
Ecuador, the world's largest banana exporter, exported 3.84 million tonnes of the fruit in 1996.
The European Union bought 1.04 million tonnes of Ecuadorean bananas in the first seven months of this year, while the United States bought 598,000 tonnes.
Sales revenue was $781 million during the period, up 44.8 percent from the first seven months of last year.
